# The distribution family

*Generated by `creditsurv family`. Every number comes from this run.*

## The rule, before the fits

Both families are taken through the whole selection, and the winner is the one whose
**selected model** sits closest to the Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence of default, in
mean absolute percentage points, over the loan ages carrying at least
100,000 loan-months. A family whose selected model turns a declared sign is
excluded whatever its fit: a model that says tighter financial conditions lengthen survival
is not a better model, it is a broken one. Inside 0.1 percentage points the
weibull is kept, because its hazard does not fall at long ages and the families
differ most exactly where the data ends and the extrapolation begins.

The likelihood is not the criterion, and not because it is inconvenient: it changed its mind
between two specifications of this same model, by 623,126 AIC points one way and 83,961 the
other.

## What each family chose

**Each family's own selection, not one specification fitted twice**

| Distribution | Formula |
|---|---|
| Weibull | credit_score + original_ltv + debt_to_income + term_years + ltv_change + unemployment_change + policy_rate_change + yield_curve_slope + consumer_sentiment + housing_starts_growth + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat')) |
| Log-logistic | credit_score + original_ltv + debt_to_income + term_years + ltv_change + unemployment_change + policy_rate_change + consumer_sentiment + housing_starts_growth + C(purpose, Treatment('purchase')) + C(occupancy, Treatment('owner_occupied')) + C(harp, Treatment('standard')) + C(mortgage_insurance, Treatment('uninsured')) + C(buyer_type, Treatment('repeat')) |

## How far each sits from the observed incidence

**Mean and worst absolute gap in percentage points, over the ages compared**

| Distribution | Mean abs gap pp | Max abs gap pp | Ages compared | Signs against the prior | Excluded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weibull | 0.1027 | 0.1607 | 222 |  | False |
| Log-logistic | 0.1498 | 0.2531 | 222 |  | False |

## The verdict

**weibull.** The families are 0.047 pp apart, inside the 0.1 pp tie, so the weibull is kept.
